note: Wing proof whiffletree, per side (left = mirror). Aircraft inverted, supported under the pod (|y| <= support station), half-fins hanging free; pads 40 x 40 mm on the lower surface over the spar line x_pad. Loads are LIMIT unless the key says _ult (= 1.5 x limit, sacrificial wing only). Pad loads already subtract the aircraft's own weight acting in the lift direction when inverted. The tree reproduces the flap shear and bending of the governing flight case at the support station; torsion is not proof-tested by it.
tree: per side: bar A joins pads 1 and 2 (inboard panel) at proof_pivot_in_y_m; bar B joins pads 3 and 4 (outboard panel) at proof_pivot_out_y_m; bar C joins the pivots of A and B at proof_pivot_side_y_m; the top bar joins both sides at the centreline (hanger load = proof_hanger_lim_N). The relief pull R acts upward on each motor tube at the wing plane through a separate sling over a pulley (not part of the tree). Step 2 (outboard, each side in turn): padded V-block under the spar at proof_out_support_y_m, pads 3 and 4 only, at proof_out_P3_lim_N / proof_out_P4_lim_N.
